summary: Re-verified from scratch at 278e45d (stale verdict at 488ce91 discarded). All three Expect lines hold. npm test at head: 91 pass, 0 fail (before I added 2 tests); plan/check.mjs: plan ok; pr-gate stubs and freeze both passed. release: proved on the real scratch repo with no Actions: release.mjs synced via PR #7, then PR #8 (README.md only) and PR #9 (plugins/harness/README.md), each followed by 'git fetch origin main && node scripts/release/release.mjs branch --push' and git ls-remote. Non-plugin merge and the sync merge made nothing; the plugin merge made release/harness-v0.1.2 at the merge sha, above tag 0.1.1; an immediate rerun made nothing. behind-notice: two mutations each turned a named test red. no-self-edit: traced all writes by reading and by strace; none is under the plugin root; I added tests for the release-branch path. Notes: (1) a merging thread's clone must have release.mjs current on disk (it runs the working-tree copy, so after a PR that changes release.mjs, fast-forward the clone before running it; my first run used a stale local copy that only knew tag and printed usage). (2) I did not copy release.yml to the scratch repo (workflow-file pushes may need extra scope and Actions is off); the scratch release.yml differs from head's and was not exercised; I read head's release.yml only. (3) Leftover scratch state: branches verify2/*, merged PRs #7-#9, release/harness-v0.1.2.
